title: events.raw_message
description: The message published on the raw events topic for one accepted event (POST /api/v1/events at ingested_at). The message has no key; its value is a JSON object.

store.description: Event store of the organization: pg (events persisted in the relational store, the normative variant) or ch (events only published to the raw topic for the events-processor / columnar store).

organization_id.description: Organization id (UUID text) written into the message.

event.description: The `event` member of the request body, as sent.

ingested_at.description: Wall clock of the API when it accepts the event (whole seconds).

metrics.description: Billable metrics of the organization before the call (default none).

expression.description: Metric expression (BE-EX); null or empty = none.

deleted.description: The metric was deleted (soft delete) before the call.

topic.description: Name of the configured raw topic (the kit runs with `events-raw`).

message.description: The JSON value of the message (decoded); number-like members are JSON strings whose spelling is part of the contract.
